strings.en: Prof. Hale: Molly and Entei, a human and{NEWLINE}a Pokémon... To think they could form a{CLEAR}family bond that goes beyond species.{CLEAR}I’m truly moved.

strings.zh: 水君『Suiiii——cun！
strings.en: Suicune: Suiiii-cun!
strings.notes: copied from a027/0356#175 (identical zh) | RV041: meaning: cry as the zh writes it (cun)

strings.zh: 雷公『Raiiii——ko！
strings.en: Raikou: Raiiii-ko!

strings.zh: 小美『咦？水君和雷公怎么走了？
strings.en: Molly: Huh? Why are Suicune and{NEWLINE}Raikou leaving?

strings.zh: 小美『啊！连炎帝爸爸也……！
strings.en: Molly: Ah! Even Daddy Entei is...!

strings.zh: 小美『为什么啊爸爸,{NEWLINE}为什么连炎帝爸爸都走了？
strings.en: Molly: Why, Daddy? Why did even Daddy{NEWLINE}Entei go away?

strings.zh: 秀力博士『城都三圣兽身上{NEWLINE}都蕴藏着巨大的能量,{CLEAR}必须要不停地在大地上奔走{CLEAR}才能宣泄它们体中的能量,{CLEAR}所以它们不能在一个地方待太久。
strings.en: Prof. Hale: Johto’s three legendary{NEWLINE}beasts all hold enormous energy. They{CLEAR}have to keep running across the land to{CLEAR}release the energy inside them, so they{CLEAR}can’t stay in one place for long.

strings.zh: 小美『啊？那小美什么时候{NEWLINE}才能再见到炎帝爸爸啊？
strings.en: Molly: Huh? Then when will Molly get to{NEWLINE}see Daddy Entei again?

strings.zh: 秀力博士『这个嘛……{NEWLINE}有缘就会再见的,小美。
strings.en: Prof. Hale: Well... If it’s meant to be,{NEWLINE}you’ll meet again, Molly.

strings.zh: 小美『呜……好吧。
strings.en: Molly: *sniff*... Okay.

strings.zh: 秀力博士『啊,那不是{VAR:0103:0}吗？
strings.en: Prof. Hale: Oh, isn’t that {VAR:0103:0}?

strings.zh: 小美『呀,{VAR:0103:0}哥哥！
strings.en: Molly: Yay, it’s big brother {VAR:0103:0}!

strings.zh: 小美『呀,{VAR:0103:0}姐姐！
strings.en: Molly: Yay, it’s big sister {VAR:0103:0}!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『好久不见啊,秀力博士、小美。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Long time no see,{NEWLINE}Prof. Hale, Molly.

strings.zh: 秀力博士『真的是好久不见。{NEWLINE}你也是来缘朱市观光的吗？
strings.en: Prof. Hale: It really has been a long{NEWLINE}time. Are you sightseeing in Ecruteak{CLEAR}City too?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我正好路过缘朱市,{NEWLINE}就顺道来这里看看。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I happened to be passing{NEWLINE}through Ecruteak City, so I thought{CLEAR}I’d drop by.

strings.zh: 秀力博士『我和小美刚刚逛完了{NEWLINE}缘朱市的所有景点,{CLEAR}现在准备回阿鲁夫遗迹研究所了,{CLEAR}你有时间的话,欢迎再来做客啊。
strings.en: Prof. Hale: Molly and I have just{NEWLINE}finished seeing all of Ecruteak City’s{CLEAR}sights, and now we’re heading back to{CLEAR}the Ruins of Alph Research Center.{SCROLL}Come and visit us when you have time.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『好的,有时间我一定去。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Sure, I’ll definitely come when{NEWLINE}I have time.

strings.zh: 秀力博士『那就先再见了,{NEWLINE}我和小美在阿鲁夫遗迹等你光临。
strings.en: Prof. Hale: Then goodbye for now.{NEWLINE}Molly and I will be waiting for you at{CLEAR}the Ruins of Alph.

strings.zh: 小美『{VAR:0103:0}哥哥再见！
strings.en: Molly: Bye-bye, big brother {VAR:0103:0}!

strings.zh: 小美『{VAR:0103:0}姐姐再见！
strings.en: Molly: Bye-bye, big sister {VAR:0103:0}!
